_comment: Google Sheet for question updates (shared by KIDS and TEEN; each app reads only its own tabs). 'tabs' (pack -> gid) and 'manifestGid' speed up lookups; tabs are also found by name if a gid changes. See ark_core/doc/CONTENT_SHEETS.md Media (pictures / audio for new questions) downloads from Firebase Storage: set firebaseBucket (<project>.appspot.com). See ark_core/doc/MEDIA.md
